fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) has gained 28.64% year-to-date, already exceeding the consensus target price of $345.63, with 24/7 Wall St. target price of $403.43.
fields.summary_ko.1: Ten consecutive quarters of EPS beat momentum has driven consensus raises, with Q4 revenue of $114.48B (+11.72%) and EPS of $2.10 exceeding consensus of $1.98.
